product_one_liner.value: Fluxco helps utilities and infrastructure project buyers, including data-center, renewable-energy, and industrial developers, turn transformer specifications into competitive bids from 150+ OEMs and manage procurement through delivery and warranty.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage footer/navigation has no pricing link; the site directs buyers to start a project or contact the company.

named_customers.notes: The closest customer-oriented report identifies one customer, Antora Energy, but does not provide two qualifying customer names.

employee_band.notes: Tracxn lists an official employee count of 13.

founded_year.notes: Tracxn reports 2025; an older directory gives a conflicting earlier year.

eng_blog.notes: The resources index contains buyer guides and transformer-industry technical articles, not posts explaining how Fluxco builds its product.

public_docs.notes: The site links to an FAQ but not product documentation, a help center, or a developer portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live careers index lists a Full-Stack Software Engineer (AI-Native Generalist) role.

model_provider.notes: Fluxco describes AI-assisted tools but does not publicly identify the model or provider in the materials reviewed.

compliance_certs.notes: Fluxco has a public privacy/legal page, but it names none of the listed certifications.

last_funding.notes: Reported as a roughly $26 million seed round in July 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The $26 million seed round was announced in July 2026, within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Account Executive and Enterprise Account Executive postings are listed.

launched_6mo.notes: A dated August 2026 report says Fluxco launched its Global Transformer Network and expanded its end-to-end service positioning.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Brian Tochman’s LinkedIn profile lists a Founder and CEO position beginning in January 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The sales posting refers generically to a CRM but does not name a CRM or sales/marketing system.
